angleRead.name: Simon Leary
angleRead.text: I'm standing on the corner of College and Manila, watching the market vendors fold their tables. The temple vigil is over, and the neighborhood has that particular quiet that comes after a collective exhale. The Oaks are 10-2, and I keep turning that number over like a stone in my pocket. Ten wins, two losses, one straight. The structure holds. But I'm not chasing the record — I'm chasing what it means that a team can change its shape and still stand. Austin Reaves is the name on the sheet, but he's not the story. The story is the load-bearing wall that doesn't move when everything else shifts around it.
